{"metadata":{"description":"On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sessions: images become markers, and a vision_describe tool sends only image + question to an OpenAI-compatible vision model","id":"gh:1335787135","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-vision-bridge","slug":"sfyyy/dsh-vision-bridge","topics":["agent","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","image-understanding","llm","multimodal","ocr","on-demand-vision","openai","openai-compatible","plugin","screenshot","vision","vision-language-model","vlm"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sessions: images become markers, and a vision_"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"describe tool sends only image + question to an OpenAI-compatible vision model"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @dsh-extension/dsh-vision-bridge"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sessions."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文文档 · npm"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A DSH plugin that gives a **text-only DeepSeek session on-demand multimodal capability**: the sessio"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"n stays on its text model for every turn, and only when the model actually needs to look at pixels —"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" a screenshot, an uploaded image, a diagram, a chart — does it call the `vision_describe` tool, whic"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"h sends **only the image(s) + a focused question** to an OpenAI-compatible vision model."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **No long context ever reaches the vision model** — a 300k-token conversation history is never sen"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"t; each vision call is just image + question, keeping cost minimal.
- **Session log and UI keep the "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"original images** — only the model *input* is rewritten to text markers.
- **Bring your own vision e"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ndpoint** — any OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` service (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Gemini proxy, lo"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"cal vLLM/One-API, …)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- The `agent/pre-step` hook records every image attachment that appears in the session (user uploads"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" **and** tool-produced screenshots, including ones nested inside `tool-result`), building an attachm"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ent index that `vision_describe` uses to resolve bytes by id.
- `session.deriveMessages()` is wrappe"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"d so that **no text-model request ever contains image blocks** (the native DeepSeek adapter rejects "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"them); images are replaced by text markers. The session event log and UI keep showing the original i"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"mages.
- DSH's built-in `llm-pi-ai` builds the OpenAI multimodal request; the plugin only maintains "},{"id":"p9s7","text":"a single `vision-bridge` provider route and does not re-implement a protocol adapter."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Image admission"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"DSH Web runs an image-capability check before a message enters the agent, based on the current DeepS"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"eek model. This plugin keeps an admission bypass so images can enter the session first; the marker r"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ewrite then guarantees no text-model request carries image blocks. When the plugin is disabled or un"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"installed, the native admission check is restored."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Check `GET /_dsh/vision-bridge/settings` for the live `value.admissionBypass` and dependency-service"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ET /_dsh/vision-bridge/settings` for the live `value.admissionBypass` and dependency-service status."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Install from the npm registry (not a local checkout) — one command:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> The `--profile` flag targets the profile you boot (`web` is the browser UI profile). Omit it or ad"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"apt it if your profile has a different name.
>
> After a new client bundle is added, restart `dsh we"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"b` once so the UI picks it up."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Configure it in **Settings → Vision Bridge** (DSH Web), or edit `~/.dsh/vision-bridge.json`:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `baseUrl` accepts an API root, a `.../v1` base, or a full `.../chat/completions` URL (the plugin n"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ormalizes it).
- `apiKey` and `apiKeyEnv` are mutually exclusive. A directly entered key is synced t"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"o the DSH credential store and referenced as `DSH_VISION_BRIDGE_API_KEY`.
- The plugin maintains exa"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ctly one `vision-bridge` route inside DSH's `llm-pi-ai.providers` and never touches other providers."},{"id":"p20s5","text":"
- `enabled: false` disables the whole chain: no tool registration, no image rewriting, no admission"},{"id":"p20s6","text":" bypass (native behavior restored)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Precedence (highest wins):** Settings page (with schema defaults) → environment variables → config"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"edence (highest wins):** Settings page (with schema defaults) → environment variables → config file."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Environment overrides:** `DSH_VISION_BRIDGE_BASE_URL`, `DSH_VISION_BRIDGE_API_KEY`, `DSH_VISION_BR"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"IDGE_API_KEY_ENV`, `DSH_VISION_BRIDGE_MODEL`, `DSH_VISION_BRIDGE_ENABLED`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## `vision_describe` tool"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Arguments**
- `attachmentIds`: image attachment ids from the current conversation (shaped like `"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"sha256:...`), one or several;
- `paths`: absolute local image file paths (`png`/`jpeg`/`webp`/`gif`)"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" — use either or both, **1–4 images in total**;
- `question`: required — a focused, specific questio"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"n about the image(s).
- **Behavior**: resolves the images → sends image(s) + question to the vision "},{"id":"p24s5","text":"model via the `vision-bridge` route → returns the text answer as a tool result.
- **Multi-image comp"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"arison** is supported: put several images in the same user message.
- Attachment ids must come from "},{"id":"p24s7","text":"the current conversation (user uploads or tool output); `paths` go through DSH's sandbox-aware file "},{"id":"p24s8","text":"ent conversation (user uploads or tool output); `paths` go through DSH's sandbox-aware file service."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Verify"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The suite covers: image-marker rewriting (including nested `tool-result`), both id- and path-based r"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"esolution, event-log attachment indexing, full-chain shutdown when disabled, and text-only sessions "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"og attachment indexing, full-chain shutdown when disabled, and text-only sessions staying untouched."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"From a local checkout:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Search keywords"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"`deepseek` · `deepseek-harness` · `dsh` · `plugin` · `vision` · `multimodal` · `vision-language-mode"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"l` · `VLM` · `image understanding` · `screenshot` · `OCR` · `image analysis` · `OpenAI-compatible` ·"},{"id":"p32s3","text":" `text-only-llm` · `on-demand vision` · `LLM agent`"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
